narration: In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, that same month. The ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. In month {layoff_month}, at the bottom of the fall and the widest the two ever ran, you and the ghost lost the job together, and the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. With no pay coming in, the ghost could hold out longer, its Safety {safety_gap}.
